theme_and_archetype.description: Premium, modern, and clean B2B SaaS marketplace. Combines enterprise authority (Archetype 4) with the approachable, frictionless experience of modern dashboards (Soft Utility). Focuses on trust, clarity, and scalability.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant for premium SaaS. Clean, readable, and authoritative.

headings.styling: tracking-tight for large headings. DO NOT use Inter for headings.

surfaces_and_shadows.inputs: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100 focus:border-blue-600
surfaces_and_shadows.modals: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-100 backdrop-blur-xl
surfaces_and_shadows.headers: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200 z-50 sticky top-0

dashboards.grid_pattern: Bento Grid (Control Room). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6

marketplace_listings.content_area: w-full md:w-3/4 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6

shadcn_customization.Tabs: Customized with pill-shaped indicators, no rigid borders.
shadcn_customization.Cards: Soft rounded-xl, subtle 3% opacity shadow, minimal borders.
shadcn_customization.Inputs: Height 44px (h-11) for better click targets, rounded-lg.
shadcn_customization.Badges: Soft backgrounds (e.g., bg-blue-50 text-blue-700), rounded-full px-3 py-1.

navigation.type: Top sticky nav for public marketplace. Sidebar nav for Buyer/Provider/Admin dashboards.

media_and_images.rules: ONLY use the provided URLs below. DO NOT use generic placeholders.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract 3D geometric shapes in deep navy and vibrant blue. Use as a subtle overlay or hero background image behind the main search bar.
Blue textured tech background for CTA banners.

company_and_sponsor_logos.description: Set of abstract minimal tech company logos. Use crop/masking to show individual logos in the 'Trusted By' section or as Provider avatars.

team_and_office.description: Professional team collaborating. Use for provider public profiles or 'About Us' sections.
Corporate office team meeting. Use for category landing pages or blog thumbnails.

mockups.description: Modern software dashboard mockup. Use in the 'How it works' or features section.

platform_specifics.language: Azerbaijani (Primary). Build UI with AZN terminology where applicable, or provide i18n structure. Example: 'Xidmətlər' (Services), 'Şirkətlər' (Companies), 'Axtar' (Search).
key_views: Homepage: Hero search with Tabs (Services/Companies), Featured Providers Carousel, Trust Logos.
Marketplace Search: Rich sidebar filters (Location, Budget, Rating, Delivery Time). Service/Company Cards with Sponsored Badges.
Public Profile: Cover image, Logo, About, Services, Portfolio, Reviews, Certificates.
Buyer Dashboard: Sidebar nav. Active Briefs, Proposals, Shortlist, Messages.
Provider Dashboard: Sidebar nav. Profile Views, Leads, Active Proposals, Plan Details.
Admin Panel: Moderation, Users, Categories, Ads, Settings.
Briefs/RFQs: Multi-step form for creating requests.

testing_and_accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="search-submit-button"`, `data-testid="provider-card-link"`).
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios > 4.5:1. Focus states must use `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500`.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React.js (use .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Create components as .jsx or .js files. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
instructions_to_main_agent.execution_order: 1. Setup Routing & Layouts. 2. Build Shared UI Components (Cards, Buttons, Inputs). 3. Build Public Marketplace Pages. 4. Build Role-based Dashboards (Buyer, Provider, Admin).
instructions_to_main_agent.design_fidelity: Do not build raw HTML tables for dashboards; use custom card-based layouts or beautifully styled Tailwind tables with subtle borders. Follow the Bento Grid pattern for dashboard widgets.
